scorecard.behavior: relia --json check emits a relia.command_result envelope with schema_version 1.0, status, exit_code, evidence_refs, and typed arrays.
Non-interactive or piped stdout defaults to JSON when no human-only mode is requested.
relia --quiet --compact check emits compact JSON while preserving status, exit_code, evidence_refs, warnings, errors, and artifacts.
Unknown commands and invalid flags return exit 2 with an invalid_usage error envelope; reserved MVP commands return typed not_implemented envelopes.
relia init creates relia.yaml when missing and relia check validates the repo operating-pack baseline.
Exit-code examples cover stable PRD exit codes 0 through 9.
make prepush-full passes with lint, fast tests, coverage, and contract validation.
